Which quote is cheaper, and by how much?

The **[Small deductible plan](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aZggCAE/view)** is cheaper. It costs **$139,035** a year, which is **$10,465** (about 7%) less than **[Guaranteed cost](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aZgfCAE/view)** at $149,500.

The trade-off is a **$2,500 deductible**, while Guaranteed cost has no deductible. Both have a $1,000,000 limit, and both were presented on 20 Sep and expire on 20 Oct.
